control_failures.control_label: inspection and monitoring of highwalls and batters

facts.title: high potential incident - kinetic exposure at G-8101

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control GROUND_CONDITION_INSPECTION: the inspection and monitoring of highwalls and batters had degraded below its design intent, and the learning team review classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the inspection and monitoring of highwalls and batters on G-8101, G-8103 and TT-8101 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in monitoring and inspecting ground conditions, specifically inspecting highwalls and batters. G-8101 (gas turbine generators) is in service for on-site generation. The task proceeded during transfer operations while the inspection and monitoring of highwalls and batters had degraded below its design intent. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 20 May 2026 a high potential incident was recorded on G-8101, G-8103 and TT-8101 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station during transfer operations; kinetic energy held as rotating equipment was not released.
